methodology: Same hard-target header, cached prefix and pruned final Keccak round for all backends. Equal requested candidates per run; full wall time includes IPC/submission/completion and winner verification. Seven rotated/reversed rounds by default; warm_each_sample controls a discarded full-range warm-up before each timed browser case and measured_sample_index identifies the native sample; session initialization and template preparation excluded. Explicit i64x2 SIMD; persistent independent Web Workers with private memories, not Emscripten pthreads. No physical traffic, energy or CPU utilization inferred.
